protocol.important_caveat: soft/raw/contextual variants are frozen-checkpoint inference probes. They localize bottlenecks but are NOT substitutes for retraining each mode from scratch for a fair ablation.

variant_meanings.raw_hard_qasa: Raw VALUE + hard exclusive ownership + original QASA.
variant_meanings.raw_hard_qasa_nonempty: Same as raw_hard_qasa, but QASA-selected hard-empty VALUE slots are blocked.
variant_meanings.raw_hard_all_nonempty: Execute every hard-nonempty VALUE slot, bypassing QASA selection.
variant_meanings.raw_soft_qasa: Same checkpoint, but raw VALUE is soft-shared at inference.
variant_meanings.raw_soft_all: Soft-shared raw VALUE and force all slots to execute.
variant_meanings.contextual_hard_qasa_nonempty: Leak probe: contextual Q-Former VALUE with same hard support; hard-empty selected slots blocked.
variant_meanings.contextual_soft_qasa: Leak upper-bound probe: contextual VALUE + soft sharing.
variant_meanings.empty_selected_only: Execute only QASA-selected slots that own ZERO hard VALUE tokens.
variant_meanings.teacher_full: Frozen CSMCIR global composed query, when dimensions match.

diagnosis.name: qasa_vs_hard_value_support_mismatch
diagnosis.interpretation: QASA is computed from soft contextual attention while VALUE may be hard-exclusive. A QASA-selected slot can therefore own zero hard VALUE tokens, while a hard-nonempty slot can be left unselected.

diagnosis.name: empty_slot_executor_is_not_noop_when_selected
diagnosis.interpretation: An edit slot with zero VALUE can still trigger a nonzero executor transition if QASA selects it, because execute() gates on selection, not VALUE activity.

diagnosis.name: hard_assignment_bottleneck_probe
diagnosis.interpretation: This is an inference-only intervention on a checkpoint trained in one mode, so it is not a fair final soft-vs-hard comparison. A large positive delta nevertheless suggests hard exclusivity itself is a bottleneck.

diagnosis.name: raw_value_information_bottleneck_probe
diagnosis.interpretation: A large contextual-V rescue suggests raw mean-pooled word embeddings are too weak (e.g. loss of phrase context/order/composition). This is a leak probe, not a proposed final architecture.

diagnosis.name: hard_partition_collapse
diagnosis.interpretation: Hard privacy prevents token copying, but it does not itself prevent a giant slot from winning most tokens.

diagnosis.name: global_teacher_upper_bound_gap
diagnosis.interpretation: If the teacher/global path is much stronger while VALUE interventions do not rescue the model, the remaining bottleneck is likely slot construction/executor capacity rather than token assignment alone.
